# API and Integration Security (API)

Rules for every HTTP API we build or call, including SAP RFC/BAPI integration and third-party services.

## SCS-API-07 Treat responses from third-party and internal services as untrusted

Level: MUST

Applies to: All (Flutter and Backend)

Policy: Data received from other APIs, SAP, vendors, AI/LLM services or webhooks MUST be validated before it is stored, shown or used to make decisions. Calls to other services MUST use TLS, timeouts and limited retries.

Implementation (Flutter):

- Parse API responses into typed models (for example json_serializable / freezed) and handle missing or unexpected fields without crashing.
- Never render server-provided HTML in a WebView without the controls in SCS-MOB-06.

Verification: Code review confirms typed validation of external responses. Tests feed malformed upstream responses and expect safe failure.
